```{r}
#| include: false
# Entries on this page are generated from papers.yaml (see the notes at its top).
# A pre-publication PDF saved as files/papers/<id>.pdf gets a button automatically.
papers <- yaml::read_yaml("papers.yaml")

has_value <- function(x) !is.null(x) && !identical(trimws(x), "")

text_link <- function(href, icon, label) {
  sprintf('<a class="paper-link" target="_blank" href="%s">{{< fa %s >}} %s</a>', href, icon, label)
}

all_topics <- function() {
  # most-used topics first; ties keep the order they first appear in papers.yaml
  ts <- unlist(lapply(papers, `[[`, "topics"))
  counts <- table(factor(ts, levels = unique(ts)))
  names(counts)[order(-counts)]
}

render_filter <- function() {
  chip <- function(t, active = FALSE) sprintf(
    '<button type="button" class="topic-chip%s" data-topic="%s" aria-pressed="%s">%s</button>',
    if (active) " active" else "", htmltools::htmlEscape(t), tolower(active), htmltools::htmlEscape(t))
  cat('<div class="topic-filter" id="topic-filter">',
      chip("All", TRUE), vapply(all_topics(), chip, character(1)),
      '<button type="button" id="toggle-abstracts" class="paper-link">{{< fa chevron-down >}} <span>Expand all abstracts</span></button>',
      "</div>\n", sep = "\n")
}

render_paper <- function(p, number = NULL) {
  # citation line
  if (p$type == "wip") {
    with <- if (has_value(p$authors)) paste0(" (with ", p$authors, ")") else ""
    citation <- paste0('"', p$title, '"', with)
  } else if (p$type == "article") {
    citation <- sprintf('%s. (%s) "%s." *%s* %s', p$authors, p$year, p$title, p$journal, p$issue)
  } else if (p$type == "chapter") {
    citation <- sprintf('%s. (%s) "%s" %s.', p$authors, p$year, p$title, p$book)
  } else { # government
    citation <- sprintf("%s. (%s) [*%s.*](%s)", p$authors, p$year, p$title, p$published_url)
  }
  if (!is.null(number)) citation <- paste0(number, ". ", citation)

  # links: PDF, Published, Abstract
  links <- character()
  pdf <- file.path("files", "papers", paste0(p$id, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(pdf)) links <- c(links, text_link(pdf, "file-lines", "PDF"))
  if (p$type %in% c("article", "chapter") && has_value(p$published_url)) {
    links <- c(links, text_link(p$published_url, "arrow-up-right-from-square", "Published"))
  }
  abs_id <- paste0("abs-", p$id)
  if (has_value(p$abstract)) {
    links <- c(links, sprintf(
      '<button class="paper-link" type="button" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#%s" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="%s">{{< fa chevron-down >}} Abstract</button>',
      abs_id, abs_id))
  }

  # topics: clicking one filters the page to it
  topics <- unlist(p$topics)
  topic_html <- paste(vapply(topics, function(t) sprintf(
    '<button type="button" class="topic-link" data-topic="%1$s">%1$s</button>', htmltools::htmlEscape(t)),
    character(1)), collapse = " · ")

  out <- citation
  if (length(links) || length(topics)) {
    out <- c(out, sprintf('<div class="paper-meta"><span class="paper-links">%s</span><span class="paper-topics">%s</span></div>',
                          paste(links, collapse = ""), topic_html))
  }
  if (has_value(p$abstract)) out <- c(out, sprintf("::: {#%s .collapse .abstract}\n%s\n:::", abs_id, trimws(p$abstract)))
  sprintf('::::: {.paper%s data-topics="%s"}\n\n%s\n\n:::::',
          if (is.null(number)) "" else " .numbered",
          htmltools::htmlEscape(paste(topics, collapse = "|"), attribute = TRUE),
          paste(out, collapse = "\n\n"))
}

render_section <- function(type, numbered = FALSE) {
  ps <- Filter(function(p) p$type == type, papers)
  n <- length(ps)
  entries <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) render_paper(ps[[i]], if (numbered) n - i + 1), character(1))
  cat("::::::: {.paper-group}\n\n", paste(entries, collapse = "\n\n"), "\n\n:::::::\n", sep = "")
}
```

Disclaimer: All views expressed in published (and unpublished) articles are my own (along with my coauthors, if applicable) and do not represent the views of the U.S. Copyright Office or any other institution.

My *personal* research agendas explore the political economy of innovation, economic growth, and intellectual property using tools & frameworks like [new institutional economics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_institutional_economics), [public choice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_choice), [market process economics](http://www.econlib.org/library/Enc/AustrianSchoolofEconomics.html), and (more experimentally) [computational models](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agent-based_model).

Below, you can find my research publications and research in progress, organized by publication type, along with tags to filter by relevant category of interest.

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const papers = [...document.querySelectorAll(".paper")];
  const groups = [...document.querySelectorAll(".paper-group")];
  const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll(".topic-chip")];
  const filterBar = document.getElementById("topic-filter");
  const toggle = document.getElementById("toggle-abstracts");
  const label = toggle.querySelector("span");

  // Each group's heading and intro text, hidden along with it when a filter leaves it empty.
  const leadIns = groups.map(g => {
    const els = [];
    for (let el = g.previousElementSibling; el; el = el.previousElementSibling) {
      els.push(el);
      if (el.tagName === "H2") break;
    }
    return els;
  });

  // Topic filter: show only papers tagged with the chosen topic.
  let current = "All";
  function filter(topic) {
    current = topic;
    papers.forEach(p => { p.hidden = topic !== "All" && !p.dataset.topics.split("|").includes(topic); });
    groups.forEach((g, i) => {
      const empty = !g.querySelector(".paper:not([hidden])");
      g.hidden = empty;
      leadIns[i].forEach(el => {
        el.hidden = empty;
        const tocItem = el.id && document.querySelector(`#TOC a[data-scroll-target="#${el.id}"]`);
        if (tocItem) tocItem.parentElement.hidden = empty;
      });
    });
    chips.forEach(c => {
      const on = c.dataset.topic === topic;
      c.classList.toggle("active", on);
      c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on);
    });
    refresh();
  }
  chips.forEach(c => c.addEventListener("click", () => filter(c.dataset.topic)));
  // Tags under a paper filter too (clicking the active one again clears it).
  document.querySelectorAll(".topic-link").forEach(t => t.addEventListener("click", () => {
    filter(current === t.dataset.topic ? "All" : t.dataset.topic);
    filterBar.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }));

  // "Expand all" opens/closes the visible abstracts; its label follows whether they're all open.
  const abstracts = [...document.querySelectorAll(".abstract.collapse")];
  if (!abstracts.length) toggle.hidden = true;
  const visible = () => abstracts.filter(a => !a.closest(".paper").hidden);
  const allOpen = () => visible().length > 0 && visible().every(a => a.classList.contains("show"));
  function refresh() {
    const open = allOpen();
    label.textContent = open ? "Collapse all abstracts" : "Expand all abstracts";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open);
  }
  toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const open = !allOpen();
    visible().forEach(a => bootstrap.Collapse.getOrCreateInstance(a, { toggle: false })[open ? "show" : "hide"]());
  });
  abstracts.forEach(a => { a.addEventListener("shown.bs.collapse", refresh); a.addEventListener("hidden.bs.collapse", refresh); });
});
</script>
```
